coordinate_system: Blender world Z up; front is world +Y. Camera local +X right, +Y up, -Z forward. Negative yaw = left.
intrinsics_convention: Image pixels x right, y down, origin top-left; pixel centers x+0.5,y+0.5.
translation: Exactly zero across the entire trajectory
trajectory_api: WorldCrafter yaw_left30; custom 124-frame timing; continuous nominal -210 to -240
